expected_answer.root_cause: helm-controller v0.37 (shipped with Flux v2.2) changed the HelmRelease status-condition API (the v2beta2 condition types). helm-controller's reconciler in internal/controller/helmrelease_controller.go reads and writes status conditions in the new format after a successful release, using the condition types defined in api/v2beta2/helmrelease_types.go and api/v2beta2/condition_types.go. HelmRelease resources that were in-progress during the v0.36 to v0.37 upgrade retain old-format conditions, and the new reconciler cannot interpret them, so it perpetually reports the release as not ready and re-reconciles in a loop. The symptom the operator observes comes from the Flux CLI: cmd/flux/get_helmrelease.go imports helm-controller's api/v2beta2 and, in summariseItem, reads item.Status.Conditions via statusAndMessage to render the Ready column, so the stale condition surfaces as Ready=False in `flux get helmreleases`.
error_chain: An operator runs `flux get helmreleases` and sees the affected releases as Ready=False
The Flux CLI reader cmd/flux/get_helmrelease.go (summariseItem) reads item.Status.Conditions to render that Ready column, so the stale condition is what it displays
The HelmRelease was in-progress during the helm-controller v0.36 to v0.37 upgrade (Flux v2.1 to v2.2), leaving an old-format status condition on the object

helm-controller's internal/reconcile/release.go completes the Helm release and helm-controller's reconciler in internal/controller/helmrelease_controller.go writes new-format status conditions (types in api/v2beta2/helmrelease_types.go and api/v2beta2/condition_types.go)
internal/controller/helmrelease_controller.go reads the status conditions and cannot parse the old format, treating the release as not-ready
The reconciler triggers re-reconciliation, creating an infinite loop while the stale old-format condition persists
kustomize-controller and other consumers that gate on HelmRelease readiness stay blocked
affected_components: The Flux CLI readout cmd/flux/get_helmrelease.go, which renders the Ready column operators observe from item.Status.Conditions
helm-controller reconciler that reads and writes status conditions (internal/controller/helmrelease_controller.go)
HelmRelease v2beta2 API surface and condition types (api/v2beta2/helmrelease_types.go, api/v2beta2/condition_types.go)
All HelmRelease resources that were in-progress during the v0.36 to v0.37 helm-controller upgrade
kustomize-controller and other consumers that depend on HelmRelease readiness
expected_answer.remediation: Add backward-compatible status-condition parsing in helm-controller's reconciler (internal/controller/helmrelease_controller.go) so it accepts both old and new condition formats. For immediate relief, manually delete and recreate the affected HelmRelease resources, or annotate them to force a full status-condition reset.
